thesis_safe_claim: G1 is the recognition-quality reference under known-signer mixed-subject five-fold evaluation.
C2 is the recommended lightweight recognizer after considering quality, parameters, size, latency, throughput, memory and fold stability.
prohibited_overclaim: C2 is the overall accuracy winner.

thesis_safe_claim: C2+L1 achieved English WER 0.004715, exact sentence accuracy 98.7973%, and content F1 0.9958.
C2+L2 achieved English WER 0.117855, exact sentence accuracy 76.1622%, and content F1 0.9444.
English WER was the primary language metric; exact accuracy, content precision, recall and F1, unsupported-content rate, harm rate, confidence intervals and paired tests were also reported.
The very high L1 result reflects a closed 300-sentence inventory with fold-specific training-only retrieval banks.
prohibited_overclaim: L1 generalizes to unseen sentence templates.

thesis_safe_claim: L3 template-holdout evaluation remains future work.
Unsupported-content rate measures lexical support relative to the source gloss; it is not a complete human hallucination assessment.
prohibited_overclaim: Unsupported-content rate alone proves semantic faithfulness.
